description: No procedures allowing facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan.
applicability: This signal applies to: Healthcare facilities and data centers Server rooms and network closets Workstations and portable devices accessing ePHI Storage media containing ePHI Physical access control systems

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review policies and procedures for emergency facility access controls. Verify that documented procedures exist for granting physical access during disaster recovery operations and emergency mode operations. Check for integration with the organization's disaster recovery and business continuity plans.

sources.title: 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C - Physical Safeguards
NIST SP 800-66 Rev 2 - Implementing the HIPAA Security Rule
